name: Priest
note: A stub (#198): their map line as the fallback bark, one ambient group, a two-node conversation. Michael, or a writing session, fills the rest.

lines: I should ring it. I cannot find the rope.
The bell stopped on the third day.

say: Peace, to you. Such as there is.
The doors are open, though few come.
Some are in the ground. Some are not.
I say the words for both. It seems only fair.
